title: Rum Deal
start: Pirate Pete, at the docks north of Port Phasmatys.

items.t: Armour and food to defeat a level 56 monster who uses melee, and a level 70 monster that uses ranged

recommended.t: Ring of charos (for use when speaking with 50% Luke)
Slayer gloves (When fighting the fever spider)

rewards.t: Holy wrench (gives extra Prayer point(s) when drinking a prayer or super restore potion)

steps.t: Recharge your prayer if you have fewer than 470 points.
Talk to Pirate Pete, north of Port Phasmatys. [Chat: Accept › 1 Of course, I fear no demon! › 1 Nonsense! Keep the money!]

sub.t: If you have the ectophial it will place you close to Pirate Pete.

steps.t: Note: If at any point you leave the area you can return via Pirate Pete. [Chat: 1 Okay!]
Complete the dialogue with Captain Braindeath. He gives you a blindweed seed.
Run south and Climb-down a Wooden Stair.
Run south to the farming patches.
Rake the south-easternmost Blindweed Patch (the only one which isn't labelled as 'trashed').
Use the seed on the patch.
Pick the blindweed once grown (can take up to 5 minutes).
Return to and Talk to Captain Braindeath.
In the south-east corner of the building, Climb-up the Ladder.
In the north-west corner, Deposit at the Hopper (1 tile east of the Pressure Barrel).
Talk to Captain Braindeath, he'll give you an empty bucket if you don't already have one.
Go to the bridges to the west and Open the Gate.

sub.t: Optional: Wear your ring of charos to distract 50% Luke.
If no ring just click Open and your character will distract him.

steps.t: Continue north and up the mountain to the Stagnant Lake.
Fill at the Stagnant Lake.
Deposit at the Hopper from earlier (keep the empty bucket for later).
Return to Captain Braindeath. He will give you a Fishbowl and net

sub.t: If you accidentally Untangle the fishbowl, just Use the bowl on the net to re-tangle them.

steps.t: Fish a total of 5 sluglings and/or karamthulhu near the farming patches (a mix of 5 will work).
Use all 5 on the Pressure Barrel next to the Hopper.
Pull the lever.
Return to Captain Braindeath. He will give you a wrench.
Enter the western room and Talk to Davey to get the holy wrench.
Right-click Use the wrench on the brewing control to the east (the object shaking crazily).
Kill the evil spirit.
Return to Captain Braindeath.
Climb-down the nearby ladder to the south-west.
With slayer gloves equipped, kill a fever spider and take its body.

sub.t: Slayer gloves are not required with high life points or when safespotting the spider behind a crate (with Magic/Ranged/Necromancy)

p: The painful way you end up getting to Braindeath Island, courtesy of Pirate Pete's magical teleporting bottle.

steps.t: Deposit at the hopper.
Return to Captain Braindeath.
With an empty bucket, turn the Output Tap (south of the machinery) to receive unsanitary swill.
Talk to Captain Donnie near the farming patches.
Return to Captain Braindeath.
Quest complete!

p: Harvesting grown blindweed in the patch.
"We interrupt this insult to bring you this soothing picture of a kitten. Normal service will be resumed shortly. Thank you for your patience."
